result.summary: Found 4 issues: one major broken/missing restaurant image, and several minor layout truncations at screen edges.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a broken-image placeholder icon instead of an actual restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL or asset loading for this card, and provide a branded fallback image (e.g., logo or cuisine illustration) instead of a generic broken-image icon.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' is clipped at the right edge, cutting off the restaurant name ('Trattoria Piccol…') with no visible truncation ellipsis handling in the title text.
issues.suggestion: If this is a horizontal carousel, ensure partial cards are an intentional affordance and apply proper text truncation with ellipsis; otherwise adjust card widths/margins so content isn't awkwardly cut.

issues.description: A category filter chip after 'Healthy' is cut off at the right screen edge, showing only a sliver of the pill with no visible label.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing or add a fade/gradient edge indicator to make it clear the row is horizontally scrollable rather than looking clipped.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar, hiding its name, rating, and delivery info.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scrollable content so cards are not obscured by the fixed bottom navigation, or verify this is simply scroll position and content remains reachable.
